content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip promise simplicity: upload a product, set a price, and sell. But this simplicity comes with dependencies. They rely on Stripe and PayPal for payments, which excludes creators in Nigeria and similar regions. Their hosting, delivery, and automation are tied to these platforms, leaving you with no ownership. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is built on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase—tools you own. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC, no buyer accounts, no platform lock-in. You own the code, the data, and the delivery mechanism. It’s not simpler—it’s more powerful.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip don’t handle restricted countries—they exclude them. Their architecture is built on Stripe and PayPal, which block Nigeria and similar regions due to regulatory or financial risks. These platforms have no alternative payment methods, leaving creators stranded. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It uses on-chain crypto payments, which are borderless and permissionless. Creators in Nigeria can accept payments from anywhere, in any cryptocurrency, without relying on third-party approval. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this infrastructure in 48 hours, configured for your products and tested end-to-end. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural solution.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad and Payhip charge 10% per transaction, plus Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30. For a $50 product, that’s $7.40 in fees. Payments take days to settle, and chargebacks are a constant risk. Sovereign commerce infrastructure flips this. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, with no additional platform fees. Payments confirm on-chain in minutes, and chargebacks are impossible. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack includes NOWPayments integration, so you’re ready from day one. The real cost? $197 for lifetime ownership, versus endless 10% cuts.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates platform dependence.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad and Payhip, you rent their infrastructure. They host your products, process your payments, and deliver your files. If they shut down or change terms, you’re locked out. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, your backend runs on Cloudflare Workers, and your files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Edge Commerce Stack automates everything: payment verification, order storage, and file delivery. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access—it’s yours. No subscriptions, no platform dependence, no compromises.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and need to sell digital products today, Gumroad and Payhip are not options—they’re dead ends. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators who value ownership over convenience, permanence over workarounds. It’s not for everyone—it requires a one-time investment of $197 and a willingness to own your stack. But if you’re tired of being locked out, it’s the only choice. Deploy in 48 hours, accept payments globally, and own every piece of your infrastructure. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s the future of digital commerce.

The Edge Commerce Stack provides full ownership of your store, backend, and delivery, with no platform lock-in. Payments are faster, fees are lower, and you’re in control. It’s not simpler, but it’s permanent.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You receive a fully operational store with no coding required. After deployment, you control everything through a simple interface.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack is a one-time payment of $197. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees. You own the infrastructure outright.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a third-party service, but your stack is designed to be resilient. You can switch to another payment provider or self-host your payment verification if needed.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack comes with 5 products loaded, but you can add unlimited products yourself. Full documentation is included.
